title: Recover access · Espaço Prelúdio
sub: Use this screen when you forgot your password. It has two steps: first reset your password by email, then reconnect your notes with the seed phrase you saved at signup.
alert: Without the seed phrase, your notes cannot be recovered. By cryptographic design, no one — not us, not Google — can decrypt what you wrote without it. If you do not have the key, you can still reset your password and resume using the account, but your previous clinical history will be inaccessible.

step1.title: Step 1 — Reset your password
step1.desc: We will send a link to your email so you can set a new password. Come back here after setting it.

step2.title: Step 2 — Recover your notes
step2.desc: Already reset your password? Paste your seed phrase below. We will rebuild your encryption key with the new password — nothing leaves your browser.
step2.labelPassword: New password (the one you just set)
step2.phraseHint: Upper/lowercase and spaces are ignored. Letters and numbers only.
